rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Federal Labor Law chapter on domestic work, reformed 2019.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: Minimum wage applies; a professional minimum set by the wage commission.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Payment rules apply; in-kind pay limited.

rules.v: Normal hours limited as for other workers
rules.vi: Jam kerja normal dibatasi seperti pekerja lain

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: Day and a half of weekly rest.

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Annual leave as for other workers.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi

rules.v: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh memilih tinggal di luar; akomodasi di rumah harus layak dan privat

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Residence permits linked to an offer.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat

decisions.nm: Random migration checks on roads (Amparo en revisión 275/2019)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
decisions.pe: Three Indigenous Mexicans were pulled off a bus by immigration officers who assumed they were Guatemalan. The Supreme Court said random migration checks on roads are unconstitutional.
decisions.pi: Tiga warga adat Meksiko diturunkan dari bus oleh petugas imigrasi yang mengira mereka warga Guatemala. MA menyatakan pemeriksaan imigrasi acak di jalan inkonstitusional.

decisions.nm: 36-hour limit in migration stations (Amparo en revisión 388/2022)
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
decisions.pe: A man was held for a long time in the migration station in Matamoros. The Supreme Court said nobody may be held in such a station for more than 36 hours.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria ditahan lama di stasiun migrasi Matamoros. MA menyatakan tidak seorang pun boleh ditahan di stasiun itu lebih dari 36 jam.

decisions.nm: Loren Laroye Riebe Star, Jorge Barón Guttlein and Rodolfo Izal Elorz v. Mexico
decisions.pe: Three foreign priests working in Chiapas were detained and expelled in 1995 without a chance to defend themselves. The Commission held that a minimum of due process applies to expulsion and found violations of the rights to personal liberty, fair trial and judicial protection.
decisions.pi: Tiga pastor asing yang bekerja di Chiapas ditahan dan diusir pada 1995 tanpa kesempatan membela diri. Komisi menyatakan bahwa proses hukum minimum berlaku dalam pengusiran dan menemukan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan, peradilan yang adil dan perlindungan hukum.

help.nm: Centro de los Derechos del Migrante (CDM)
help.de: Free help for Mexican workers on US visas such as H-2A and H-2B, before they leave, while working and after they return. Never charges workers.
help.di: Bantuan gratis bagi pekerja Meksiko dengan visa AS seperti H-2A dan H-2B, sebelum berangkat, saat bekerja dan setelah pulang. Tidak pernah memungut biaya dari pekerja.
